name: XCC_REFRESH_TREE_HISTORY
description: This table contains the control budgets and tree versions impacted by the Refresh Tree for Budgetary Control process. It also contains those tree versions that are not extracted by the Prepare Control Budget Definition process for a control budget.

columns.name: REFRESH_TREE_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Primary key that uniquely identifies this refresh tree history row.

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: The tree version for which the Refresh Tree for Budgetary Control process was run.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to XCC_CONTROL_BUDGETS table. The control budget impacted by the Refresh Tree for Budgetary Control process.

columns.name: REFRESH_TREE_SUCCESS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the tree refresh was successful.

columns.name: RECALC_REQD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether balances for this control budget must be recalculated.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CHANGE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of action performed by a user on the tree version. The valid values are: A (Addition), D (Deletion), M (Modification).

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
